text: Jardine Cycle & Carriage's Annual Report 2023 shows its Astra holding as 'Astra (50.1%)' and describes Astra as a leading business group operating in Indonesia and listed on the Indonesia Stock Exchange.
short: JC&C's Annual Report 2023 lists Astra (50.1%), a group listed on the Indonesia Stock Exchange.
